advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. Our own code uses zod 4.6.7, which is fixed; this copy is the Expo CLI's private zod 3 (node_modules/@expo/cli/node_modules), used only by the dev server on developer and CI machines to validate dev-tools plugin descriptions from installed packages, never data from users. It is not in the API, the dashboard, or the shipped guard-app bundle (the app resolves zod to 4.6.7). No zod 3.x release has the fix (3.25.76 is the last); remove this entry when the Expo CLI moves to zod >= 4.6.6.
